notes.title: Sakura Alien 3 - Release
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8132109/f500ee90dd51fdfc1137c356a294d2a121fe0da7.png[/img]
When Haru discovers that his friend, Hiyori, was hiding a huge secret, he’s forced to say goodbye to her. Haru misses Hiyori, however, and he’s determined to see her again – even if he has to travel into the furthest recesses of space to do it. In doing so, Ena and Haru tumble into surprising complications, hindering the pair to fully enjoy their trip to visit Hiyori.

Find out what those entail in Sakura Alien 3: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022500/Sakura_Alien_3/

Missed out on the previous story? 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28070/Sakura_Alien_Bundle/

notes.title: Sakura Alien 3 - Coming soon
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8132109/b07fb8a1a27f78592f2e0e2542860a8cdd68f4eb.png[/img]
After parting from Ena and our protagonist Haru, they begin to miss Hiyori more by the minute. One day, Ena gets a crazy idea: Why not visit Hiyori? 

Though Haru has always loved stargazing, he’s never travelled amongst them before. How would they travel through space and can you just enter another planet? 

Find out more in Sakura Alien 3 and wishlist it right now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022500/Sakura_Alien_3/

notes.title: Sakura Succubus 9 is out now
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8132109/858273f4ae3662f2f914f60702fe7afc0f5439b1.png[/img] After years of her retirement from the music industry, the legendary idol Mihama Shizuru comes back on stage, with no other idol on her side than our beloved Ayu but she is less than enthused.

Hiroki accompanies Ayu to Astoria alongside Hifumi, Cosmos, and Alice in the hopes of cheering Ayu on, but he's starting to worry his efforts will be for nothing.

Will Ayu's concert with Shizuru be a success - and who's this mysterious woman Hiroki runs into who seems so interested in him?

notes.title: Sakura Isekai Adventure - Release soon!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/8132109/4d42f6b8ba4be91b1b420b08e81fb36e76ccae54.png[/img]
Aki’s ordinary life is turned upside-down when she’s summoned to the magical land of Anthem by a cute cat-eared witch, named Mina.

Mina enlists the help of Aki, our heroine, and Scarlet, a cheerful foxgirl, to track down Luna and punish the brigands who kidnapped her. Our trio’s journey will be far from easy, however. Attacked by thieves, assaulted by slimes, and encumbered by Aki’s own incompetence, Aki’s new life in Anthem gets off to a poor start.

Can an awkward, unassuming office lady like Aki really become a hero?
Find out soon in Sakura Isekai Adventure, wishlist it now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646050/

Or grab it in the Sakura Bundle:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/710/Sakura_Bundle/

notes.title: Sakura Isekai Adventure - Coming soon
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8132109/4d42f6b8ba4be91b1b420b08e81fb36e76ccae54.png[/img]
Have you been waiting for a yuri game from us? 
Then you can be thrilled to hear from this new title - Sakura Isekai Adventure. 

Follow our heroine Aki in this new story.
Though she enjoyed her humble life, she was never one for adventures, which changes, when she gets summoned into a new and unknown world. Forced into the role of a heroine, Aki needs to assist her summoning companion Mina, who is on her own quest. Mina wants to rescue her dear priestess Luna, who was kidnapped.

Can our protagonist help Mina and what may happen on a journey within an unknown world and strangers as your companions? 

Wishlist Sakura Isekai Adventure now and find out for yourself:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646050
